description: This source file contains the implementation and initialization code for the DataTables jQuery plugin, including license, version, and license information, as well as internal utility functions, class and method definitions, and functionality for paginating, searching, sorting, and manipulating HTML tables in a web application. The file also includes framework setup for AMD, CommonJS, and browser environments.

classes.name: DataTable
classes.description: Main constructor for the DataTables plugin, providing a powerful API for table manipulation, sorting, filtering, pagination, and rendering. Handles initialization, configuration, and internal state management.
